description: Object kinds a script can place (objects[].kind). Each kind lists its fields; at (position, metres), rotation (degrees), scale, hidden, parent (ride on another object: at becomes relative to it), part (with parent: ride on one of its named parts, e.g. a balance pan on the beam or a hat on "<critter>#head"; then at is measured from that part's pivot, the centre of a head, in the parent's own units, so it and the child's size are multiplied by the parent's size, while a child without part is placed in metres) and pivot ([x, y, z]: the point the object turns and grows about) apply to every kind. Any teaching object (or any other object) may use on: { "line": "<number_line id>", "value": 0.75 } instead of at to stand on a number line at that value.

fields.shape: shapes.json name (required); for thin boards, mats, signs and plates use plate (a 1 x 0.04 x 1 slab)
fields.face: true for eyes, rosy cheeks and a smile on the front
fields.feeling: starting feeling for a face (face: true)

number_block.description: A rounded toy block with its number on the front and back faces.

fields.size: type size, default 1: the cap height is about 1.41 x size, the x-height 0.98 x size, and descenders (g, j, p, q, y) reach 0.47 x size below the baseline (Andika; other fonts differ a little)

letter.description: Extruded 3D text, centred on x and standing on the font baseline: at is the baseline, so flat-bottomed letters touch it and g, j, p, q and y hang below it (letters, digits, short words).

fields.clip: starting clip, default the character's idle
fields.feeling: starting feeling (Robo shows it with his face)

character.description: A rigged glTF character that plays catalog clips.

fields.area: [width, depth] of the drop zone, default [8, 4]

confetti.description: Seeded confetti that falls when a burst action fires it.

fields.color: colors.json name, overrides the body colour
fields.feeling: starting feeling: happy (default), sad, surprised, angry, worried, sleepy
fields.recolor: { "<colour a part uses>": "<new colour>" } (colors.json names): rebuilds the parts drawn in one colour in another, e.g. { "leaf": "brown", "pink": "yellow" } for a wilted plant; the main colour too

critter.description: A toy animal that bobs, blinks and wags; targets <id>#head and named parts (tail) take rotation tweens; its eyes prop closes its eyes (sleep).

fields.color: colors.json name, overrides the main colour
fields.recolor: { "<colour a part uses>": "<new colour>" } (colors.json names): rebuilds the parts drawn in one colour in another, e.g. { "leaf": "brown", "pink": "yellow" } for a wilted plant; the main colour too

prop.description: A toy object built from parts (catalog/models.json and catalog/models/*.json). Named parts (a lid, a door, a plank) are targets <id>#<part> for turn, move, wiggle and spin.

bubbles.description: Soap bubbles that float up and pop (with soft pop sounds) when a burst action fires them.

stars.description: A backdrop of slowly twinkling stars (no flashing) for night scenes.

fields.minuteHand: false starts with the long hand hidden

clock.description: A teaching clock that stands on its rim and faces the camera; the clock move turns its hands to a time (the hour hand moves with the minutes).

fields.aim: [x, y, z] the spot it points at (world)
fields.beam: true draws a faint cone of light

lamp.description: A spotlight that casts real shadows (shadow puppets, a torch in the dark). Place it with at; point it with aim; show and hide fade it.

weather.description: Rain, snow, falling leaves or petals that keep falling while the object is shown (show to start, hide to stop).

group.description: An empty holder: give other objects parent: <this id> and move, turn or grow them all as one (a rocket made of parts, a tray of cookies).

fields.length: metres from the first to the last value, default 8
fields.step: a labelled tick every step, default 1
fields.minor: equal parts between labelled ticks, default 1 (4 for quarters)
fields.labels: "numbers" (default: labelled ticks), "fractions" (every tick, e.g. 1/4, 2/4, 3/4, 1), "none", or a list of strings (one per labelled tick, or one per tick)

number_line.description: A toy number line along x (at is its centre, on the floor): a rounded beam on two legs, 0.56 m high, with ticks hanging down its front and the numbers under them. Objects stand on it with on: { line, value } and leap along it; build pops the ticks in one by one, draw grows it from the left.

fields.shaded: parts shaded from the left at the start, default 0
fields.label: true shows "shaded/parts" over the bar (it follows shade)

fraction_bar.description: A bar standing up, facing the camera, cut into equal parts with gaps between them. Parts are targets <id>#p1 ... for move, turn, mark and highlight.

fields.shaded: slices shaded at the start (from 12 o'clock, clockwise), default 0
fields.label: true shows "shaded/parts" over the circle

fraction_circle.description: A pie standing on its rim, facing the camera, cut into equal slices from 12 o'clock going clockwise. Slices are targets <id>#s1 ... for move (pull a slice out), turn, mark and highlight.

fields.item: dot (a ball, default), any shapes.json name, or a props model name
fields.trays: true puts a tray under each row (equal groups)

array.description: Rows and columns of equal things standing up like a pegboard, row 1 on top (at is the bottom centre). Items are targets <id>#i1 ... (row by row) for mark and highlight.

fields.upright: true stands it like a wall chart; otherwise it lies flat on the floor (row 1 at the back)

grid.description: Unit squares on a white board for area and perimeter. Cells are targets <id>#c1 ... (row by row) for mark and highlight; shade colours them, trace runs round the edge.

fields.color: default orange (alternate layers are a little lighter)
fields.box: true draws a clear box around them

cubes.description: Unit cubes stacked into a box shape for volume (at is the bottom centre). Cubes are targets <id>#c1 ... (bottom layer first) for mark and highlight; build order layers stacks them layer by layer.

fields.from: [x, y, z] start (relative to at, so world when at is left out) (required)

pointer.description: A chunky 3D arrow (cause and effect, food chains, energy flow); draw grows it from start to tip.

fields.point: [x, y, z] the spot it names (relative to at)
fields.target: or an object id (placed before it): the leader points at 0.6 of its height
fields.offset: [x, y, z] from the point to the card's centre, default [1.2, 1, 0]
fields.color: text, leader and dot colour, default ink

callout.description: A label on a card with a leader line and a dot at what it names (parts of a plant, a vertex); draw runs the leader out, then pops the card.

fields.arc: true (default) draws the arc between the rays (a square corner at 90)
fields.label: true (default) writes the degrees ("45°") outside the arc

angle.description: Two rays from a vertex (at; lift it off the floor) facing the camera: the first along +x, the second turned by degrees. open turns it wider or narrower.
